target_customer: Investors (hedge funds, private equity, venture) and consumer brands that buy analytics on company performance
problem: Investors lacked timely, independent data on how public and private consumer companies were really performing between earnings reports.
business_model: B2B data subscription sold to investors and brands

founders.name: Michael Babineau
founders.background_notes: YC page says about 15 years as an engineer before founding, and later founded Turnstile; no employers or education listed.

competitors.name: Earnest Research
competitors.what: Consumer transaction data analytics for investors

technical_complexity.rationale: Building panel data pipelines, anonymization and statistical projection over billions of transactions was standard data engineering with hard modeling parts.

defensibility.rationale: Accumulated transaction history and panel relationships were hard to rebuild, though competitors sold similar data.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Bloomberg acquired the company in December 2020 rather than copying it; terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: Hedge funds were adopting alternative data; the 2015 TechCrunch launch coverage said Second Measure covered over 1 percent of U.S. consumer spending and gave live analysis of public and private companies.

branding.domain_note: secondmeasure.com, now operated as Bloomberg Second Measure.

brand_strength.rationale: Known within alternative data circles; no evidence of brand driven growth or press about the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Second Measure sold transaction based company analytics to investors during the rise of alternative data, raised a 20 million dollar Series A in 2019 co-led by Bessemer and Goldman Sachs, and was acquired by Bloomberg in December 2020 for undisclosed terms. Proprietary panel data and timing explain the outcome; a YC bio claims a nine figure exit, which is unverified.
notes: Total raised about 25.5M after the Series A, so about 5.5M of earlier seed funding (Jefferies, Norwest, Shasta, Foundation Capital, YC) is undated and not recorded as rounds. Exit price undisclosed; the founder's YC page claims a nine figure exit, unverified. Earnest competitor entry rests on its founding year only; traction at the time was not found. Name origin not found.
